label: copy-phase input m (fed-back m)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase; never on original tokens or <DEL>. About 73% of activation mass (63% of active steps) lands on steps where the fed-back input is m, and nearly always at recall_idx >= 2. Weaker, sparse activations occur on fed-back e, 1, j, v and 0. Precision is low, though: only about 12-14% of copy-phase m inputs fire. Which token is output alongside the m matters (rate is higher when out_tok is j/v/i/a/u/m; restricting to those gives precision 0.32 but recall 0.34). Largest activations are m at copy step t=12 in L=9 sequences (m was original token 2, recall_idx 3); rate peaks at recall_idx 3-4. The unit does not fire on m in the original phase or on the first copy step.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=12: m, e, 1, v; t=13: m, e, 1, 0; t=11: m, 1, e, 0) and the token being output (most: j, v, m, i, a, u; least: -, l, 3, r); timing cues that raise it most: L=3 & t=5, L=3, L=4 & t=6.
